environment.description: local kind clusters on a single development host; not a production benchmark

scenarios.name: Malformed policy is rejected at admission
scenarios.observed: The FleetAccessPolicy "malformed" is invalid:  * spec.permissions[0].tool: Invalid value: "x') || true || ('": spec.permissions[0].tool in body should match '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$' * spec.placement.placementRef.name: Invalid value: "": spec.placement.placementRef.name in body should be at least 1 chars long * spec.subjects[0].spiffeID: Invalid value: "https://not-spiffe.example/agent": spec

scenarios.name: Valid identity and tool, policy exists, no lease
Permitted tool with an active lease (east, west)
Cluster outside the placement receives no grant
Prohibited tool (read_secret) and tool outside the lease
Wrong SPIFFE identity, allowed tool
Lease asks for a tool the policy does not permit
Lease asks for 1h against a 10m maximum
scenarios.observed: DurationExceedsMaximum: requested duration 1h0m0s exceeds policy maximum 10m0s

scenarios.name: Allowed tool, prohibited argument (replicas=1000)
scenarios.observed: replicas=3 ALLOW, replicas=1000 ALLOW: kube-agentic-networking v0.2.0 matches params.name only, so argument limits are not enforceable

scenarios.name: Deleting a lease revokes it on every cluster
Lease expiry: ALLOW before, DENY after
Concurrent leases for one subject are independent
scenarios.observed: health DENY after its expiry, restart ALLOW

scenarios.name: Placement change moves authorization (west out, edge in)
Drift: rendered XAccessPolicy deleted on a managed cluster
scenarios.observed: right after deletion: DENY (gateway not yet updated); 2s later: DENY; ALLOW restored 8622ms after deletion

scenarios.name: Controller restarts (FleetPermit and agentic-networking) keep an active grant stable
Hub disconnected before expiry: managed clusters stop honouring the lease on time
scenarios.observed: DENY 278ms (east) / 520ms (west) after expiresAt; rendered policy still present on east (xaccesspolicy.agentic.networking.x-k8s.io/fleetpermit-sre-remediation-a46c9779b9dca599), so the denial came from the data-plane time bound

scenarios.name: Reconnection: hub marks the lease Expired and withdraws stale grants
Decision matrix: 2 agents x 3 clusters x 4 tools, lease active and expired
scenarios.observed: 48 of 48 real calls matched the expected outcome

scenarios.name: Why the default-deny anchor exists (upstream behaviour without any XAccessPolicy)
scenarios.observed: without anchor: ALLOW; with anchor: DENY

scenarios.name: Controller ServiceAccount is least-privilege
